t: Praise be to Allah Who made me such that I have not died, nor am I sick, nor have my veins been infected with disease, nor have I been hauled up for my evil acts, nor am I without progeny, nor have I forsaken my religion, nor do I disbelieve in my Lord, nor do I feel strangeness with my faith, nor is my intelligence affected. nor have I been punished with the punishment of peoples before me. I am a slave in your possession, I have been guilty of excesses over myself. You have exhausted your please over me and I have no plea (before you) I have no power to take except what you give me, and I cannot evade except what you savest me from. O My Allah! I seek your protection from becoming destitute despite your riches, from being misguided despite your guidance, from being molested in your realm and from being humiliated while authority rests with you. O My Allah! Let my spirit be the first of those good objects that you take from me and the first trust out of your favours held in trust with me. O My Allah! We seek your protection from turning away from your command or revolting against your religion, or being led away by our desires instead of by guidance that comes from you.
